review_response_tasks.stem: The form is missing a signature, so the office cannot ____ the application yet. It remains unprocessed.
review_response_tasks.rationale: process：process办理申请与unprocessed对应；consume消耗/forecast预测/forgive原谅不表办理手续。

review_response_tasks.stem: The tutor asked for a ____ account: include the main steps, but leave out unrelated details.
review_response_tasks.rationale: concise：保留mainsteps删无关细节=concise简洁；permanent永久/hostile敌对/accidental偶然不表篇幅精炼。

review_response_tasks.stem: The note is marked “provisional”, which means the arrangement is ____. It may still change.
review_response_tasks.rationale: temporary：maychange对应temporary暂定；irreversible不可逆反，compulsory强制/invisible不可见非暂定。

review_response_tasks.stem: She decided to ____ the offer rather than accept work she could not complete.
review_response_tasks.rationale: decline：ratherthanaccept拒绝decline；compose创作/preserve保留/estimate估算不表示拒offer。

review_response_tasks.stem: The new rule applies ____ all members, including those who joined last week.
review_response_tasks.rationale: to：applyto适用于；applyat/for/of不能在此表示规则适用对象。

review_response_tasks.stem: The author, ____ first novel won a local prize, will speak on Friday.
review_response_tasks.rationale: whose：从句firstnovel前需所属whose；who主格不修饰novel，which物，whom宾格。

review_response_tasks.stem: ____ in plain language, the instructions were easy for newcomers to follow.
review_response_tasks.rationale: Written：instructions被写用Written分词；Writing主动主语不合，Towrite目的主语应写者，Writes限定不能作状语。

review_response_tasks.stem: The hall was empty when we arrived because everyone ____ already left.
review_response_tasks.rationale: had：到达过去之前已离开hadleft；has现在完成，will后left错，isleft被留非主动离开。

review_response_tasks.stem: ____ surprised the visitors was the small size of the original model.
review_response_tasks.rationale: What：What引主语从句并作surprised主语；That不充缺少的主语，Whether不充名词角色，Who把让人惊讶的物误作人且后model非人。

review_response_tasks.stem: The question is ____ we can finish before the room closes.
review_response_tasks.rationale: whether：完整wecanfinish无名词缺口，whether引能否；what/who需句内成分，whose需所属名词。

review_response_tasks.stem: We missed the train. If we had left ten minutes earlier, we ____ caught it.
review_response_tasks.rationale: would have：已错过的过去反事实wouldhavecaught；will后caught错，are/is被捕与赶车施受反且主语we不配is。

review_response_tasks.stem: By next Friday, the team ____ completed all three interviews.
review_response_tasks.rationale: will have：byfuture完成willhavecompleted；will后须complete，is/werecompleted被动主语team方向/数不合。

review_response_tasks.stem: Despite ____ tired, she checked the figures once more.
review_response_tasks.rationale: being：despite介词后being动名词；was/were限定不能直接作介词宾语，be原形不合。

review_response_tasks.stem: To her ____, the parcel contained the notebook she had lost.
review_response_tasks.rationale: surprise：toonesurprise名词固定；surprised/surprising形容或分词，surprisingly副词不作her后的名词。

review_response_tasks.stem: The teacher asked me what ____ before the alarm rang.
review_response_tasks.rationale: I had seen：宾语从句陈述序Ihadseen且过去此前；hadIseen/didIsee倒装问句序，have seeing结构错。
